title: Universal Application Generator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Produces application source code, configuration, dependencies, and tests from structured requirements. From a structured requirement set, the generator emits working source code, config files, dependency manifests, and a test suite that the code must pass. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success. "Boundless" means the capacity to extend this system, not a claim that its records or capabilities are already infinite. Record counts reported are actual populated counts; generated records are labeled "generated" and never mixed with sourced facts.
